units.function: Mocked route tests for revision-anchored document annotation reads, thread/comment mutations, activity/reference synchronization and bounded review-path recovery.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> real issue routes/error middleware -> mocked issue/document/annotation/reference/heartbeat/activity services plus an incomplete DB stub; a real external-object safe-sync path is incidentally invoked and fails.
units.keyDataModels: Issue/document/revision, text quote/position anchor, annotation thread/comment author and Run fields, reference summary, review interaction expiry and Agent wake payload.
units.lifecycle: Read document with compact or expanded annotations -> mutate revision/thread/comment -> sync references/activity/external projection -> normally avoid Agent wake; if final review path disappears, enqueue one bounded recovery wake.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed run failed 7/7 from Supertest listen denial; approved unsandboxed run passed 7/7. However two external-object sync calls logged real TypeErrors because the DB stub lacks transaction, and the suite ignored them. Route composition and intended wake behavior are covered, but persistence, authorization, projection consistency and validation are not.
units.designRationale: Support precise collaborative review on mutable documents while avoiding wake storms and recovering once when a board edit removes the last active review path.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs human/Agent evidence review where annotations remain bound to exact evidence revisions, authors and responsibility state, with controlled notification/escalation and consistent projections.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT revision/selector anchoring, compact-by-default reads, optimistic baseRevisionId and idempotent bounded recovery. Reimplement mutation commands with tenant/role/responsible-human authorization, sanitized/limited content, thread versions, atomic document/reference/activity/outbox state and projection-lag visibility. Escalate lost review paths according to accountable-human responsibility rather than only waking an Agent.
units.responsibilityConflict: Activity names actions but tests do not prove accountable human, exact Work/evidence contract, prior/new revision digest, resolver authority or review outcome. A lost human review path triggers Agent recovery without proving who remains responsible.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 7/7 Supertest listen EPERM failures
2026-08-19 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest: 7/7 passed with two unasserted external-object sync TypeError warnings
units.securityFindings: HIGH authorization gap: access service always allows and only one Agent cross-company read is negative; board tenant, Agent write/checkout and resolver authority are untested. HIGH consistency gap: external-object sync failed twice during a passing run, proving best-effort projection failure is invisible to the API/test. HIGH content/evidence gap: markdown/comments/selectors lack tested size, XSS, Unicode normalization, anchor bounds and revision digest. MEDIUM concurrency gap: no thread version/idempotency/race tests. Missing atomicity across document/annotation/reference/activity/outbox state can leave responsibility evidence inconsistent.
